displayName: Guitar Coach API - unusual authentication failure volume

documentation.content: More than 20 failed sign-in attempts (auth.sign_in security events, outcome=failure) in a 5-minute window, across all users/IPs. Backed by the security_auth_sign_in_failures log-based metric (see docs/monitoring/log-based-metrics/auth-sign-in-failures.json) — apply that log-based metric first. Better Auth's own Redis-backed rate limiter already caps this at 5/60s per IP+route (src/auth/auth.ts), so a broader spike across many IPs suggests distributed credential stuffing rather than one noisy client. Log-based custom metrics use the reliable logging.googleapis.com/user/ prefix, so this metric.type is not subject to the OTLP-naming caveat that applies to the other policies in this directory.
